services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Rochdale
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full boiler replacements, we handle every aspect of domestic plumbing and heating.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water damage spreads fast. We attend burst pipes and major leaks within an hour, stop the flow, and make safe. No call-out fee.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Cold radiators or strange noises? Our engineers diagnose faults quickly and carry spares on the van. Annual servicing keeps your warranty valid.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: We fit new boilers from all major manufacturers and handle all the paperwork. Fitted boilers come with a 10-year parts guarantee.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New radiators, pipework, and controls installed to modern efficiency standards. We'll advise on your home's heating needs before quoting.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Cold spots on radiators or corrosion? We bleed, power-flush, or replace radiators to restore heat flow throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap installations, waste pipe work, and supply lines for new bathrooms and kitchens. We work cleanly and tidy up after ourselves.

about_pullquote: I started KS because I was sick of cowboys charging over the odds.
about_para_1: KS Plumbing and Heating was founded over 15 years ago on Thirlmere Road, Rochdale. We began as a one-man operation fixing leaks and boiler breakdowns for friends and neighbours. Gas Safe registration and a reputation for honest, fast work meant the phone kept ringing. Today we're still independent, still locally based, and still turn up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Rochdale homeowners trust us because we charge fair prices, show up on time, and don't leave a mess. We don't upsell unnecessary work. If your boiler can be repaired, we'll tell you; if it needs replacing, we'll explain why and give you options. Nine out of ten customers call us back or recommend us to their friends.
reviews_heading: What Rochdale Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the kitchen at half past eleven at night. Called KS and they were round within an hour. Kevin fixed it properly, dried everything off, and charged a fair price. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas. I was panicking but KS fitted a new one the next day. The whole job was explained step by step, no stress, and the guarantee paperwork was sorted there and then.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Been using KS for radiator bleeding and a new bathroom install. They're reliable, work is tidy, and they don't flog you stuff you don't need. Best plumber I've had in years.
reviews.author: Paul D.
